1981-2415-6772-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1580-2511-4871-5075.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1376-4359.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4030-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

When Melira enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

Thornbite Staff attached to The Master.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aphetto Vulture.
When Aphetto Vulture dies, its first ability and The Master trigger.
Resolve the Aphetto Vulture trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Master trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Aphetto Vulture from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting Aphetto Vulture from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Malcolm trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.

Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and three other lands, causing you to gain ten life.

Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.

Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Cast Austere Command by paying {4}{W}{W}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

Cast Shifting Wall for {1}.
